scope: Exact polygon lost/gained for all actual GND-filled layers; all candidate non-GND straight tracks on each immediately adjacent physical layer checked at actual halfwidth. Includes low-speed and power tracks, not just selected differential nets. Comparison isolates reference-plane changes using candidate signal geometry in both plane states. No SI qualification.
note: Summed individual track intersections can double-count joined overlap. The zero/nonzero differential result does not rely on summing disjointness.
